title: Taken unknowingly to the hangar building with an EG&G escort

tellings.quote: >> Um, my EGNG escort knew I was going to uh that building that day, but um

plain: A doctor named Greg Rogers, who worked with NASA (the US space agency), says he was once taken to a secret hangar building without knowing where he was going. His escort from EG&G, a private contractor that worked at secret government sites, knew he was headed to that building that day, he says. Rogers tells this firsthand as the lead-up to what he says he saw inside: a UFO.
